page.layout: One printed page, visible at the right of the scan, cut off at its outer edge, so many line ends are missing. The left page is blank apart from a library stamp, the digitiser's box and show-through, none of which is transcribed. Right page: a decorative border at the head, then a dedication in larger type with a large initial "R" lower down.
page.notes: The right page is cut off at the outer edge of the scan, so most line endings are missing. The large initial "R" and the line "Ed..." may belong to one word. The top border is ornamental, not text. Words in the left-hand show-through, the library stamp "Ex Bibliotheca Academiae Augustae" and the digitiser's box were left out on purpose. The readings of the cut-off lines are guesses from the visible letters and were not transcribed beyond what is shown.
